title: User joint on two position and orientation markers
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG7.6 (docs/dev/design/pythonUserItems.md 5.8): n constraint equations of the marker quantities, Jacobian (or numerical), reaction forces, chain rule with the marker Jacobians in C++; example 6: a screw joint.
releaseNotes: New ObjectJointUser: a joint on two rigid markers whose 1 to 6 constraint equations are a Python user function of the positions and rotation matrices of the markers, e.g. a screw joint; the Jacobian by the translations and rotation increments of the markers is given by jacobianUserFunction or computed by central differences; works with index 3 and index 2 solvers; test model userJointTest.py.
